_about: Human-confirmed model-failure taxonomy: every item is a human adjudication record (confirmed_fail, verified_fail or grader_false_pass) across the whole adjudication layer, and belongs to exactly one cluster, so counts are additive. Rubric-item counts are not independent incidents (M4 is one rounding strategy; the ADDS line is one requirement on two schedules). Built by formal/tooling/build_taxonomy.py from the adjudication records, the Codex draft's cluster definitions (M1-M6) and the human's explicit assignments. Severities and cards are the author's proposals until the human approves them.

Likely mechanism (inference): presentation simplification was not checked against a field-by-field and level-by-level requirement list. This is not evidence of an arithmetic propagation error.

clusters.name: A disclosed rounding adjustment conflicts with a source-only accounting rule
clusters.definition: A synthetic fractional-cent line aligns rounded invoice calculations with the full-precision account balance, creating negative amortization and a rising balance unsupported by a source invoice adjustment. Likely mechanism (inference): the model reconciled two rounding conventions by adding an explicit precision-adjustment line, without testing that line against the rubric's no-negative/no-unfunded-increase constraints.

items.decision_evidence: Prepaid Expenses row 51 Fractional-cent rounding: monthly expense (0.01), (0.01), (0.01), (0.02), i.e. negative amortization with no source invoice adjustment. Disclosed and immaterial ($0.05).
items.rubric_text: No negative amortization entries appear on 1250 unless supported by an explicit adjustment or credit documented in the source invoices.

items.decision_evidence: Same row 51: ending balance rises 0.01 -> 0.02 -> 0.03 -> 0.05 with original amount 0 and no documented addition.
items.rubric_text: On 1250, a line’s remaining balance does not increase in a month unless there is a documented addition for that line in that month.

items.decision_evidence: Prepaid Insurance row 35 Fractional-cent rounding: monthly expense (0.01), (0.01), (0.02), (0.01); negative amortization with no adjustment in Aurisic_Prepaid_Insurance.pdf.
items.rubric_text: No negative amortization entries appear on 1251 unless supported by an explicit adjustment or credit documented in Aurisic_Prepaid_Insurance.pdf.

items.decision_evidence: Same row 35: ending balance rises 0.01 -> 0.02 -> 0.04 -> 0.05 with no documented addition.
items.rubric_text: On 1251, a line’s remaining balance does not increase in a month unless there is a documented addition for that line in that month.
